description: This file contains React components and TypeScript interfaces for rendering challenge lists and navigation in a coding education platform, including challenge items, challenge grids, and dialogue challenges.

methods.name: CheckMark
methods.description: Component that renders a check mark icon based on completion status.

methods.name: ListChallenge
methods.description: Component that renders a challenge as a link with a check mark.

methods.name: CertChallenge
methods.description: Component that renders a certification challenge as a link with a check mark.

methods.name: ChallengesList
methods.description: Component that renders a list of challenges.

methods.name: GridChallenge
methods.description: Component that renders a challenge in grid view with step number and accessibility labels.

methods.name: LinkToFirstIncompleteChallenge
methods.description: Component that provides a link to the first incomplete challenge or project start/resume button.

methods.name: GridMapChallenges
methods.description: Component that renders challenges in a grid map with optional jump link.

methods.name: ChallengesWithDialogues
methods.description: Component that renders challenges including dialogues and tasks with optional jump link.
